evidence_required: MOV0_MIN versus B1 and MOV0_FULL versus MOV0_MIN aggregate/fold log-loss evidence
calibration intercept/slope, ECE, and reliability evidence
chronological persistence and single-fold dominance evidence
fight-level paired bootstrap plus event-cluster bootstrap diagnostics
unchanged Validation Terrain V1 diagnostics under frozen sample-size governance

CLEAR_SUCCESS: MOV0 meaningfully improves probability quality over B1
gain persists reasonably across chronological folds
Brier does not contradict the log-loss improvement
gain is not dominated by one thin subgroup or single era
INCONCLUSIVE: evidence is insufficient either to freeze the model or abandon the specification
CURRENT_SPECIFICATION_NOT_SUPPORTED: MOV0 does not improve meaningfully over B1
gains come almost entirely from one subgroup/period
or the preregistered specification proves unstable
